name: Half Moon Pose
description: Standing balance on one leg with the torso and lifted leg parallel to the floor.

source.title: Yoga Journal Pose Library
source.note: Stick-figure approximation. Twists and binds can't be fully shown in 2D.

setup: Start in Triangle Pose, or a wide stance with the front foot turned out.
Bend your front knee and place your lower hand on the floor or a block ahead of your front foot.

keyframes.name: Step wide
keyframes.cue: Step the feet wide apart, arms out to the sides.

keyframes.name: Half Moon Pose
keyframes.cue: Balance on the right leg, lift the left leg, reach the left arm up.

cues: Use a block under the lower hand.
